# CERTIFICATE OF ANALYSIS ## ERM®- EF213
PETROL
Mass fraction
Certified value 1) [mg/kg]Uncertainty 2) [mg/kg]

1) Unweighted mean of three sets of results obtained using isotope-dilution mass spectrometry applied as primary method of measurement. The value is traceable to the International System of Units (SI). 2) The certified uncertainty is the expanded uncertainty estimated in accordance with the Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement (GUM) with a coverage factor k = 2, corresponding to a level of confidence of about 95 %. This certificate is valid for one year after purchase.
